adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and applies it unconditionally to `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no upper bound or sanitization beyond `to_i`. A caller can supply an arbitrarily large `limit`, causing the server to fetch and serialize a very large member list (and it also does `total = group.users.count` every time). While previous behavior differed, the resulting code as shown is vulnerable to oversized requests and bulk enumeration/DoS for large groups.
